parameter_status: All numerical inputs below are explicit illustrative assumptions; not measured, fitted, or claimed commercial limits
limits: Uniform through-plane effective-medium slab approximation across 12 thickness x rate combinations

Area-specific ionic resistance (ASR = L / kappa_eff) and ohmic drop (DeltaV_ion = j * ASR) are independent of projected area A; reference_area_cm2 is used only to convert to total current I = j * A and total resistance R_ion = ASR / A
Only effective ionic ohmic drop, not total cell polarization
Fixed areal capacity in the thickness sweep is a partial sensitivity comparison, not a self-consistent fixed-composition electrode-loading series
No concentration depletion, solid diffusion, reaction kinetics, temperature dependence, current-collector spreading, plating or safety predictions
No validation or fitting to Jeon measurements
